Dear Milestone Reviewer,
Thanks for taking the time to review our milestone submission so thoroughly. We completely understand your concerns regarding international participation, and we’d love to clear up what happened on the ground.
1. At the start of Workshop 1, our host Melody Shao and speaker Jimmy Lee (Cardano Ambassador in Vietnam) actually began presenting in English. However, looking at the live viewer interaction, it became clear that the vast majority of live audience members at that moment were local. To keep the session engaging for the live crowd, Jimmy made an on-the-fly decision to switch to Vietnamese. Workshop 2 followed a similar pattern. That said, all slide decks and core training materials were created 100% in English, ensuring non-Vietnamese participants could easily follow along and complete their assignments.
